meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频镜头加上推拉缩放与镜头运动动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让视频片段有缩放、推拉或镜头运动等动画效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, and camera-move keyframes to video shots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're animating zooms, punch-ins, or camera moves inside video shots.

howto.what: 给 HyperFrames 合成里的画面主体写可定位(seek-safe)的关键帧,做推近、缩放、平移、遮罩、3D 等运动,并用 hyperframes keyframes 等命令截图校验。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推近、缩放、相机运动等 2D/3D 关键帧,或要用 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等实现时触发;不管场景策略、品牌设计、字幕等。

say.text: 给这个镜头里的标题做一次推近、再回位的关键帧
say.note: 会在包装层写 scale 关键帧并截图校验

say.text: 让产品图从 A 框平滑移到 B 框,中途别卡顿
say.note: 会用 FLIP 或一段连续 transform 补间

say.text: 给我看看这版关键帧的抽样截图,含最终帧
say.note: 会运行 hyperframes keyframes 出图证明

howto.what_en: Writes seek-safe keyframes for the moving subject in a HyperFrames composition — punch-in, zoom, pan/reframe, masks, SVG draw, 3D depth — then verifies with hyperframes lint/check/keyframes, focused shots and snapshots.
howto.when_en: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in, zoom, camera moves or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, or GSAP, CSS, Anime.js etc. Not for scene strategy, brand design or captions.

say_en.text: Keyframe a punch-in on this shot's title, then settle back
say_en.note: Writes scale keyframes on a wrapper and verifies with shots

say_en.text: Move the product card smoothly from box A to box B, no hitch
say_en.note: Uses FLIP or one continuous transform tween

say_en.text: Show me sampled snapshots of these keyframes, including the final frame
say_en.note: Runs hyperframes keyframes to prove it
